summary: Defines MIB objects for managing IEEE 802.3 Medium Attachment Units (MAUs), and extends earlier work to cover 10 gigabit per second MAUs. It obsoletes RFC 1515 and RFC 2668. It is a proposed standard that has been replaced by RFC 4836.

eli5.summary: A MAU is the part that plugs a device into the Ethernet wire. This lists the gauges a manager can read on it, including for very fast links. RFC 4836 has since replaced it.
